products.title: 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box
products.description:
Factory-sealed 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball hobby box — 20 packs of 4 cards, one autograph per box, and the first Topps NBA Debut Patch Autographs of the Cooper Flagg rookie class.
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 20 packs per box
## Product highlights
- 2025/26 Topps Chrome Updates Basketball is headlined by one of the most coveted cards in the hobby: NBA Debut Patch Autographs, making their Topps Basketball debut!
- Considered a pinnacle chase across The Hobby, these 1-of-1 grails, featuring game-worn NBA Debut patches, arrive for the first time in basketball with standout rookies like Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, and Dylan Harper leading the charge!
- The chase is rounded out by superstars such as Stephen Curry, LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, Anthony Edwards, Nikola Jokić and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and more across major SSPs and Autographs!
- The 200-card base set features refreshed imagery for the rookies, vets and legends, all showcased in updated, in-season photography featuring Statement, City and Classic Edition uniforms and of course, a deep rainbow of Chrome parallels!
- Minions NBA are SSPs that reimagine NBA stars as Minions in collaboration with Illumination for a fun, highly collectible crossover insert. In addition, look out for the Denim Tears SSP parallel, and newly added Captains, Celebración case hit inserts!
- Autograph collectors can chase a robust lineup of Topps Chrome Autographs, including special appearances from Druski and Spike Lee!
- The 1980–81 Topps Basketball Autographs deliver another loaded checklist, while the ultra-cool Lava Lamp Rookie Autographs add a groovy twist!
## Box break averages
- 1 Autograph

The 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box delivers the iconic Chrome collecting experience with an exciting lineup of NBA stars, top rookies, and standout players from the season. Featuring the signature chromium finish collectors love, this release offers the chance to chase stunning refractors, autograph cards, rare inserts, and exclusive parallels. With a fresh selection of updated player content and premium Chrome designs, the 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box is a must-have for basketball collectors looking to add some of the hobby’s most sought-after cards to their collection.

products.title: 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football Hobby Box
products.description:
Factory-sealed 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football hobby box — 20 packs of 4 space-themed Chrome cards with Light Years, Cosmic Dust and Supernova case hits.
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 20 packs per box
## Product highlights
- 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football launches the iconic Chrome brand into orbit with a dynamic, space-inspired design that brings a fresh twist to the hobby.
- The 200-card base checklist highlights today’s top NFL talent and the league’s most exciting newcomers, giving collectors a mix of stars from every generation.
- A variety of eye-catching inserts await, including fan-favorite themes like Star Clusters and Extraterrestrial Talent, along with additional cosmic-inspired surprises.
- Be on the lookout for ultra-rare case hits such as Light Years, Cosmic Dust, and Supernova, each offering unique visual appeal and collectability.
- Collectors can chase the ambitious Planetary Pursuit set, a buildable collection that spans the entire solar system—from the blazing Sun out to distant Pluto.
- Autograph content is also a major highlight, featuring four distinct signature sets. These include on-card autographs randomly inserted throughout the product, spotlighting elite veterans, standout rookies, and the next wave of NFL stars.
## About this box
Blast into a new collecting experience with the 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football Hobby Box! Featuring dazzling space-inspired designs and the signature Chrome finish, this premium release showcases top rookies, star veterans, and legendary football icons in a visually stunning format. Collectors can chase vibrant parallels, exclusive inserts, and coveted autograph cards while uncovering some of the hobby’s most eye-catching designs. Packed with color and premium hits, 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football delivers an exciting break that’s truly out of this world.
